name: Connected Minimal-Non-Ample Structure Theorem
statement: For a conditioning-minimal non-ample class, connectedness, having at least three concepts, having an irredundant isometric one-inclusion embedding, and being the tope set of a non-free simple uniform oriented matroid are equivalent. Every proper convex antipodal subgraph of its one-inclusion graph is a hypercube, and the oriented-matroid rank equals its VC dimension.
proof: Ample conditionings supply ambient geodesics between non-antipodal pairs. A third concept splices such geodesics between antipodes, proving isometry. Proper convex antipodal subgraphs lie in an ample conditioning and are cubes; global nonampleness then forces antipodality. Uniform-oriented-matroid tope recognition gives the classification and its converse.
